notes.title: Early Access v2.0.0
notes.content: The default branch for Early Access v2.0.0 has been updated, with several adjustments implemented to enhance performance compared to the test version.

notes.title: Early Access v2.0.0 Test
notes.content: Just uploaded a preliminary version of Early Access v2.0.0!

notes.title: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) Support
notes.content:
Hello, I been working in some performance improvements and including new locations for the future updates.

-FSR now available from the settings menu.

Thanks

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.2 Virtual Texturing Trial
notes.content: Virtual Texturing ON

notes.title: Slide Enhancements
notes.content:
Hi, I did some improvements to the sliding mechanic
-Distance
-Ground Friction 
-VFX
-Perspective

Thanks

notes.title: Movement key input bindings & Pyramid puzzle tweaks
notes.content:
Hello all, I added the movement key axis inputs to be able reassigned from the settings menu, I know a lot of players don't use the default A,W,S,D so now you are able to bind to any key.

Some players were getting confused during the "Find a Way to Enter the Pyramid" task so I added some extra hints and a new magic tornado block.

Thanks!

notes.title: Puzzle Tweaks
notes.content:
Hello, I did some tweaks to the Lab Puzzle, some info drones were added for support, loot system was reworked as well. 

Thanks

notes.title: Item Interaction & Melee detection Enhancement
notes.content:
Hello guys, I did some changes to the basic items interaction, so now they are added automatically no interaction required and aditionally some of them can be collected to be used later from the inventory when you have full ammo, health, magic etc.

Some enhancements to the mele weapons, now they are using complex capsule detection for a better hit result.

Thanks

notes.title: UI scale Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello I did some UI scaling to fit when playing resolutions 2k,4k or custom.

Thanks

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.2
notes.content:
Quick update that includes:

-Checkpoints
-New melee locomotion & Animations
-Interaction messages
-Info drones

Thanks

notes.title: Checkpoints now available
notes.content:
Hello, here's a quick update that enables checkpoints during main quests, these respawn your character on the last checkpoint reached, now available when you start a new game.

Thanks

notes.title: Melee Weapons Locomotion
notes.content:
Hello All, I added new animations and locomotion to the Melee Weapon stance, now each weapon has different animations.

Speed & range were tweaked too, new "Emerg Axe" weapon available by default.

Thanks

notes.title: Melee Weapons Locomotion
notes.content:
Hello All, I added new animations and locomotion to the Melee Weapon stance, now each weapon has different animations. 

Speed & range were tweaked too, new "Emerg Axe" weapon available by default.

Thanks!

notes.title: Teleporters, player speed & IA tweaks
notes.content:
Hello all, I added a couple of new portals to make the navigation easier when respawning, also the player speed was increased, IA was tweaked to inflict less damage and random spawning was reduced too, iventory now slowdown time to allow yo to easy craft and use items.

Thanks

notes.title: Missing Quest Marker Fix
notes.content: Missing quest Marker  for the task "Search for clues in crashing areas" update :)

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello all, I made some tweaks and changes to the game based in the feedback that I been receiving , these are:

-Audio levels and input configuration fix
-Basic Motion blur controls
-Melee weapon range
-IA damage balance 
-Damage protection during cut scenes
-Damage protection during cyber Nahual transformation
-Quest helpers
-Reduced breathing and sway effects during ADS
-New Flashlight Input

Thanks

notes.title: Melee weapons radial hotfix
notes.content: Hello all, I just did some adjustments to the melee weapons improving the radial distance

notes.title: Motion blur & sound configuration Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello guys, I just added some basic motion blur controls and sound configuration issues are fixed now!
Thanks for your support :)

notes.title: Flashlight Hotfix
notes.content: Quick patch to balance difficulty and new input added to toggle ON/OFF Flashlight :)
